item.title: Ricardo Montaner Sues UMG Over Music Catalog Rights: ‘Wrongful Claims of Ownership’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our show, where we dive into the latest music news. Today, we're talking about Latin star Ricardo Montaner, who's making headlines with a lawsuit against Universal Music Group. Let's break it down.
[Short music transition]
Host: Montaner is suing UMG over the ownership of his early album masters, specifically his first five releases between 1986 and 1992. These albums include some of his biggest hits, like "La Cima Del Cielo" and "Castillo Azul". According to the lawsuit, Montaner recorded these albums under a deal with Venezuelan label Love Records, which was later sold to PolyGram and eventually acquired by UMG.
[Short music transition]
Host: The issue here is that Montaner claims UMG hasn't paid him any royalties since taking control of his masters in 2001. He served a legal notice in 2022 to reclaim his rights, and he believes he owns his first five albums as of 2024. However, UMG is disputing this, saying Montaner's termination notice was invalid.
[Short music transition]
Host: This dispute has led to a standoff between Montaner and UMG. Montaner has already entered into a distribution deal with ADA Latin, but UMG is trying to shut it down, claiming they still own the masters. Montaner is now asking the courts to declare him the rightful owner of his albums and to stop UMG from interfering with his rights. He's also seeking financial damages, which could exceed $1 million.
[Short music transition]
Host: This case highlights the complexities of music ownership and the ongoing battle between artists and record labels over rights and royalties. Montaner has spoken out about the "predatory" contracts he signed early in his career, and he's fighting to take control of his music.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's the latest on Ricardo Montaner's lawsuit against Universal Music Group. We'll be keeping an eye on this story as it develops. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next episode!
